name: Software Engineer
summary: Builds and maintains production software across web, mobile, or services, collaborating with product and QA to ship reliable features.
whatTheyDo: Design, implement, test, and maintain application features and services while participating in code review, debugging, and release cycles.
responsibilities: Deliver features with acceptable quality bars
Own assigned modules end-to-end when asked
Follow team security and coding standards
prerequisites: Basic data structures and SQL awareness
technicalSkills: One primary language deeply (e.g. Java, TypeScript, PHP, Python, Dart)
careerTransitions: Can specialize into backend, frontend, mobile, or platform roles
bangladeshNotes: In Bangladesh job ads (e.g. Bdjobs fintech and product roles reviewed around 2026-09), titles often appear as Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer with stacks varying by employer—Java/Spring and React/Flutter appear in fintech ads such as Nagad's SSE posting, while service companies frequently list JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, or .NET. Many ads prefer a CS-related degree or equivalent experience, but wording varies; do not assume a single required stack or salary band.
commonQualifications: BSc in CSE/Software Engineering or related (often preferred)
Portfolio or GitHub with real projects
Internship or prior shipping experience for junior roles
experienceExpectations: Public ads commonly state ranges from ~1–3 years for mid-junior through 3–7+ for senior titles; always read the specific posting.
